chapterInfo.content:
18
Adamfofa ne asomdwoeɛpɛ
1Deɛ wate ne ho no hwehwɛ anoyie daa,
na adepa biara yɛ no ahi.
2Ɔkwasea nni nhunumu ho anika,
na mmom sɛ ɔbɛyi n’akoma adie.
3Ɔbɔnefoɔ ba a, animtiabuo nso ba,
na adapaa ne ahohora na ɛnam.
4Nsuo a emu dɔ ne ɔbarima anomu nsɛm,
asutene a ɛba yie ne nyansa abura.
5 # Deut 1.17 Ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔhwɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ anim,
na wɔdane ɔteneneeni asɛm ani atemmuo mu.
6Ɔkwasea ano ma ntɔkwa ba,
na n’afono frɛfrɛ asotorɔ.
7 # Mmb 13.3; 16.26 Ɔkwasea ano ne ne sɛeɛ,
na n’anofafa ne ne kra fidie.
8 # Mmb 26.22 Asomkasani nsɛm te sɛ mfremfremadeɛ,
na ɛsiane kɔ ɔyafunu mpia mu.
9 # Mmb 10.4 Deɛ ɔtoto n’adwuma aseɛ nso,
ɔdesɛefoɔ nua ne no.
10 # Mmb 14.26; Dwom 20.1 Aban denden ne AWURADE din,
ɛno mu na ɔteneneeni dwane korɔ, na wɔkora no.
11 # Mmb 10.15 Ɔdefoɔ ahonyadeɛ ne ne kuro a ɛyɛ den,
na ɛte sɛ ɔfasuo a ɛkorɔn n’adwene mu.
12 # Mmb 16.18; 15.33 Deɛ ɛdi ɔsɛeɛ anim ne sɛ ɔbarima akoma a ɛma ne ho soɔ,
na deɛ ɛdi animuonyam anim ne ahobrɛaseɛ.
13Deɛ ɔbua asɛm ansa na ɔteɛ no,
ɛyɛ agyimisɛm ne aniwuo ma no.
14 # Mmb 15.13, 15 Onipa honhom tumi soa yadeɛ,
na honhom a ɛdi yea deɛ, hwan na ɔbɛtumi asoa?
15Nhunumufoɔ akoma nya nimdeɛ,
na anyansafoɔ aso hwehwɛ nimdeɛ akyiri kwan.
16 # Gye 43.11 Onipa ayɛyɛdeɛ bɔ kwan ma no,
na ɛde no ba nnipa akɛseɛ anim.
17Deɛ ɔbɔ ne nkuro kane yɛ sɛ ɔteneneeni
kɔsi sɛ ne yɔnko ba bɛpeepee mu.
18 # Mmb 16.33 Ntonto pata ntɔkwa,
na ɛpae atumfoɔ ntam.
19Onua a wɔafom no sene kuro denden,
na ntɔkwa te sɛ abankɛseɛ akyiri adaban.
20 # Mmb 12.14; 13.2 Ɔbarima anomu aba ma ne yafunu mee,
n’anomu nnɔbaeɛ mee no.
21 # Mmb 13.3 Owuo ne nkwa wɔ tɛkyerɛma tumi so,
na deɛ ɔdɔ no no bɛdi n’aba.
22 # Mmb 19.14; 31.10 Deɛ wanya yerɛ no, wanya adepa,
na wanya AWURADE hɔ anisɔ.
23Kyɛwpa na ohiani de kasa,
na ɔdefoɔ bua asɛmdenden.
24Deɛ ɔfa nnamfo pii no de sɛe ɔno ara ne ho,
nanso adamfo bi wɔ hɔ a ɔfam ho sene onua.

pageProps.chapterText:
Deɛ wate ne ho no hwehwɛ anoyie daa,
na adepa biara yɛ no ahi.
Ɔkwasea nni nhunumu ho anika,
na mmom sɛ ɔbɛyi n’akoma adie.
Ɔbɔnefoɔ ba a, animtiabuo nso ba,
na adapaa ne ahohora na ɛnam.
Nsuo a emu dɔ ne ɔbarima anomu nsɛm,
asutene a ɛba yie ne nyansa abura.
Ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔhwɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ anim,
na wɔdane ɔteneneeni asɛm ani atemmuo mu.
Ɔkwasea ano ma ntɔkwa ba,
na n’afono frɛfrɛ asotorɔ.
Ɔkwasea ano ne ne sɛeɛ,
na n’anofafa ne ne kra fidie.
Asomkasani nsɛm te sɛ mfremfremadeɛ,
na ɛsiane kɔ ɔyafunu mpia mu.
Deɛ ɔtoto n’adwuma aseɛ nso,
ɔdesɛefoɔ nua ne no.
Aban denden ne AWURADE din,
ɛno mu na ɔteneneeni dwane korɔ, na wɔkora no.
Ɔdefoɔ ahonyadeɛ ne ne kuro a ɛyɛ den,
na ɛte sɛ ɔfasuo a ɛkorɔn n’adwene mu.
Deɛ ɛdi ɔsɛeɛ anim ne sɛ ɔbarima akoma a ɛma ne ho soɔ,
na deɛ ɛdi animuonyam anim ne ahobrɛaseɛ.
Deɛ ɔbua asɛm ansa na ɔteɛ no,
ɛyɛ agyimisɛm ne aniwuo ma no.
Onipa honhom tumi soa yadeɛ,
na honhom a ɛdi yea deɛ, hwan na ɔbɛtumi asoa?
Nhunumufoɔ akoma nya nimdeɛ,
na anyansafoɔ aso hwehwɛ nimdeɛ akyiri kwan.
Onipa ayɛyɛdeɛ bɔ kwan ma no,
na ɛde no ba nnipa akɛseɛ anim.
Deɛ ɔbɔ ne nkuro kane yɛ sɛ ɔteneneeni
kɔsi sɛ ne yɔnko ba bɛpeepee mu.
Ntonto pata ntɔkwa,
na ɛpae atumfoɔ ntam.
Onua a wɔafom no sene kuro denden,
na ntɔkwa te sɛ abankɛseɛ akyiri adaban.
Ɔbarima anomu aba ma ne yafunu mee,
n’anomu nnɔbaeɛ mee no.
Owuo ne nkwa wɔ tɛkyerɛma tumi so,
na deɛ ɔdɔ no no bɛdi n’aba.
Deɛ wanya yerɛ no, wanya adepa,
na wanya AWURADE hɔ anisɔ.
Kyɛwpa na ohiani de kasa,
na ɔdefoɔ bua asɛmdenden.
Deɛ ɔfa nnamfo pii no de sɛe ɔno ara ne ho,
nanso adamfo bi wɔ hɔ a ɔfam ho sene onua.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
